releaseNotes: Fixed the V872 Welcome-to-Running handoff regression in Signal Tower runtime arbitration.
Made a successfully committed dual-state Autoscale bank the runtime hardware-verification SSOT instead of gating it on transient engineering catalog projection state.
Stopped repeated 7-9 second Autoscale bank preparation loops after Welcome DONE, allowing the sealed-in PRI10 Running state to take control on the next scan.
Added explicit invalidation of the fast bank before any ordinary Signal Tower preset/configuration hardware apply, preserving fail-closed safety when the recipe truly changes.

en: Fixed the V872 Welcome-to-Running handoff regression in Signal Tower runtime arbitration.
A committed dual-state Autoscale bank is now the runtime hardware-verification SSOT and is no longer disabled by transient engineering catalog refresh state.
Removed the repeated Autoscale bank preparation loop after Welcome DONE so PRI10 Running takes control on the next scan.
Ordinary Signal Tower preset/configuration hardware applies explicitly invalidate the bank before changing the recipe.
ko: V872에서 발생한 Signal Tower Welcome 완료 후 Running 전환 회귀를 수정했습니다.
성공적으로 COMMIT된 dual-state Autoscale bank를 runtime hardware verification SSOT로 사용하여 일시적인 engineering catalog 갱신이 bank를 무효화하지 않도록 했습니다.
Welcome DONE 이후 반복되던 Autoscale bank 재준비 루프를 제거하여 다음 scan에서 PRI10 Running이 즉시 제어권을 가져오도록 했습니다.
실제 Signal Tower preset/configuration 하드웨어 변경 시에는 bank를 먼저 명시적으로 무효화하여 fail-closed 안전성을 유지합니다.
